raw_text:
Smart Shield evolves Argo Smart Routing; best practices remain applicable. Monitor Cloudflare changelog.

- Always check editability before attempting to enable/disable Argo; verify `editable: true` in GET before PATCH. If `editable: false`, do not attempt to modify; check billing, Enterprise+ plan, holds/suspensions, and token scopes.
- Set up billing notifications; billing and a valid payment method are required. Use production only; disable for dev/staging. Combine with Tiered Cache.
- Monitor analytics: 500+ requests in 48h needed for detailed metrics; latency 1–5 minutes. Only proxied (orange-clouded) traffic counts; DDoS/WAF-mitigated traffic is excluded from billing.
- Test changes in staging before production. Use TypeScript SDK, implement retry logic, and document zone-specific settings.
- Handle errors: unavailable zone—check Enterprise+ eligibility and billing; unchanged status/`editable: false`—check permissions (`Zone:Argo Smart Routing:Edit`) and zone restrictions. Contact Cloudflare support if eligibility is unclear.
- Rate limit: typically 1200 requests per 5 minutes per API token. On `RateLimitError`, read `error.response?.headers.get("retry-after")` and implement exponential backoff.
- Spectrum apps: no hard limit; each can enable Argo independently.

Links: https://developers.cloudflare.com/argo-smart-routing/ ; https://developers.cloudflare.com/smart-shield/ ; https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/ ; https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-typescript ; https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-python
